videos.title: Does TSA Actually Allow AirTags In Your Luggage? Here's What The Rules Say
videos.description:
Flying can be a stressful experience, and lost luggage is a big reason why. Keeping track of your suitcase or carry-on with an AirTag seems like a no-brainer. But with so many rules governing batteries on flights, is this actually allowed by the TSA?
